QuestionStmt.S:
$\mathrm{C_2H_5OH(l) + 3O_2(g) \rightarrow 2CO_2(g) + 3H_2O(l)}$

The value of enthalpy change ($\Delta H$) for above reaction at 27 °C is $-1366.5$ kJ mol⁻¹. Then value of internal energy change for the same reaction at this temperature will be

Solution.S:
The relation between $\Delta H$ and $\Delta U$ is:

$$\Delta H = \Delta U + \Delta n_g RT$$

where $\Delta n_g$ = moles of gaseous products − moles of gaseous reactants.

For the given reaction:

Gaseous reactants: 3 moles of $\mathrm{O_2}$ (ethanol and water are liquids).
Gaseous products: 2 moles of $\mathrm{CO_2}$.

$$\Delta n_g = 2 - 3 = -1$$

Temperature $T = 27^\circ$C = 300 K.

$R = 8.314$ J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ = $8.314 \times 10^{-3}$ kJ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.

$$\Delta U = \Delta H - \Delta n_g RT = -1366.5 - (-1) \times 8.314 \times 10^{-3} \times 300$$

$$= -1366.5 + 2.4942 = -1364.0058 \approx -1364.0 \text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

Final Answer: $$\boxed{-1364.0 \text{ kJ mol}^{-1}}$$

Hence, the correct option is B.
